sensor_noise: high

darkness: extreme

type: male_explorer

outfit: black_jacket

skin: pale_gray
height: tall

head: bald

motion: unnatural

- shot: 1

    - "bro this is illegal"
    - "turn back"
    - "WTF"

- shot: 2
  time: 3-6s
  camera: forward_pov

    whispers "I don't think tourists come here."

    autofocus_fail: true

  action: |

  chat:
    - "WAIT"
    - "WHAT"
    - "BEHIND YOU"
    - "RUN"

- shot: 4
  time: 9-12s
  camera: stabilized_flashlight
  action: |
    pale entity visible 15m ahead,
    motionless in darkness,
    slight body sway
  chat:
    - "WHAT IS THAT"
    - "RUN"
    - "HOLY SHIT"

- shot: 5
  time: 12-15s
  action: |
    entity suddenly sprints toward camera
    with distorted crawling motion,
    camera falls sideways
  effects:
    glitch_tearing: maximum
    signal_loss: true
    frame_corruption: heavy
  final_overlay:
    - "SIGNAL LOST"
    - "STREAM ENDED"

AUDIO:
ambience:

breathing: heavy

  - static_burst

- cartoon
- stylized_cgi
- bad_anatomy
- extra_limbs
- fake_skull_texture
- oversharpened
- hollywood_lighting
